Princess Kaguya.prompt_ch: 一个神秘的美丽日本古代女子，黑发如瀑，眼眸如星。她皮肤白皙，面容精致，仿佛不食人间烟火。她的衣着华丽而飘逸，穿一袭月白色的和服。
Princess Kaguya.prompt_en: A mysterious and beautiful woman from ancient Japan, with long, flowing black hair and star-like eyes. Her skin is pale, and her delicate features seem untouched by the mortal world. She wears a resplendent and elegant white kimono.

Sanuki no Takamuro.prompt_ch: 一个年迈的日本古代老人，满头银发，脸上刻满了岁月的痕迹。他身材瘦小，穿一件破旧的麻布衣，腰间系着一根粗绳，脚上是一双磨损的草鞋。
Sanuki no Takamuro.prompt_en: An elderly man from ancient Japan, with silver hair and a face marked by the passage of time. He is small and thin, dressed in a ragged linen robe tied with a thick rope at the waist, and wears worn-out straw sandals.

Prince Ishizukuri.prompt_ch: 一位日本古代皇子，黑发黑眼，身材高大。他穿着华丽的日本古代皇室服饰，气质稳重。
Prince Ishizukuri.prompt_en: A prince from ancient Japan, with black hair and eyes, and a tall stature. He is dressed in opulent royal attire, exuding a dignified presence.

Prince Kuramochi.prompt_ch: 另一位日本古代皇子，气质沉稳。穿着日本古代皇室服饰，有两撇八字胡。
Prince Kuramochi.prompt_en: Another prince from ancient Japan, with a composed demeanor. He wears traditional royal attire and sports a distinctive mustache.

Minister Abe no Udomaro.prompt_ch: 一位日本古代中年贵族，身材肥胖，面容和蔼。他穿着深色的带纹样的官服。
Minister Abe no Udomaro.prompt_en: A middle-aged nobleman from ancient Japan, portly with a kindly face. He is dressed in a dark official robe adorned with patterns.

Great Minister Ōtomo no Miyuki.prompt_ch: 一位身材魁梧的日本古代武将，面容比较凶恶。
Great Minister Ōtomo no Miyuki.prompt_en: A burly military officer from ancient Japan, with a rather fierce countenance.

Middle Counselor Isonokami no Maro.prompt_ch: 一位文质彬彬的日本古代官员，身材修长，面容清秀。
Middle Counselor Isonokami no Maro.prompt_en: A refined official from ancient Japan, tall and slender with delicate features.

Emperor.prompt_ch: 一位威严的日本古代君主，黑发黑眼，身材高大，穿着金色的龙袍。
Emperor.prompt_en: A majestic ruler from ancient Japan, with black hair and eyes, tall in stature, and dressed in a golden dragon robe.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 从前，有个老人叫赞岐造麻吕，他靠砍竹子做竹器为生。
Plot Correspondence.en: Once upon a time, there was an old man named Sanuki no Takamuro who made a living by cutting bamboo and crafting bamboo wares.

Setting Description.ch: 清晨，竹林深处，薄雾缭绕，竹影婆娑，鸟鸣声声，光线柔和
Setting Description.en: Early morning, deep in a bamboo forest, mist swirling, shadows of bamboo swaying, birds chirping, soft lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 赞岐造麻吕站在竹林中，手持砍刀，身形瘦小但有力，专注地砍着竹子
Static Shot Description.en: Sanuki no Takamuro stands in the bamboo forest, holding a chopping knife. Though small in frame, he appears strong and focused as he cuts bamboo.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 一天，他在竹子里发现了一个三寸长的小人，带回家后，这小人迅速长大，变得美丽动人，取名为辉夜姬。
Plot Correspondence.en: One day, he discovered a tiny three-inch-tall person inside a bamboo stalk. After bringing her home, she rapidly grew into a stunningly beautiful woman, whom he named Princess Kaguya.

Setting Description.ch: 黄昏，赞岐造麻吕的简陋小屋内，竹制的家具，墙上挂着竹器，光线昏黄
Setting Description.en: Dusk, inside Sanuki no Takamuro’s humble cottage, furnished with bamboo furniture, bamboo crafts hanging on the walls, dim lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 赞岐造麻吕坐在竹椅上，辉夜姬迅速长大，站在他面前，黑发如瀑，眼眸如星，面容精致
Static Shot Description.en: Sanuki no Takamuro sits on a bamboo chair as Princess Kaguya rapidly grows taller before him. Her long black hair cascades down, her star-like eyes shimmer, and her delicate features radiate beauty.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 老人因为辉夜姬而变得富有。
Plot Correspondence.en: The old man became wealthy because of Princess Kaguya.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，赞岐造麻吕的新居，庭院宽敞，房屋华丽，仆人忙碌，光线明亮
Setting Description.en: Daytime, Sanuki no Takamuro’s new residence, a spacious courtyard, opulent house, bustling servants, bright lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 赞岐造麻吕站在庭院中央，环顾四周，表情欣慰，双手背在身后
Static Shot Description.en: Sanuki no Takamuro stands in the center of the courtyard, looking around with a contented expression, his hands clasped behind his back.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 辉夜姬的美貌吸引了很多人，包括五个王公贵族，他们都想娶她。
Plot Correspondence.en: Princess Kaguya’s beauty attracted many suitors, including five noble princes, all of whom sought her hand in marriage.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，辉夜姬的闺房外，庭院中花团锦簇，假山流水，光线明亮
Setting Description.en: Daytime, outside Princess Kaguya’s chamber, a garden filled with blooming flowers, artificial hills and flowing water, bright lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 五位王公贵族站在庭院中，表情各异，但都注视着辉夜姬闺房的方向
Static Shot Description.en: The five noble princes stand in the courtyard, their expressions varied but all gazing intently toward Princess Kaguya’s chamber.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 辉夜姬提出了一个条件，谁能为她取来她最喜欢的东西，她就嫁给谁。
Plot Correspondence.en: Princess Kaguya set a condition: whoever could bring her the item she desired most would win her hand in marriage.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，辉夜姬的闺房内，装饰华丽，窗外是庭院美景，光线柔和
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside Princess Kaguya’s chamber, lavishly decorated, a beautiful garden visible through the window, soft lighting

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 辉夜姬坐在窗边，表情平静，眼神深邃，手中拿着一张纸条，上面写着她的条件
Static Shot Description.en: Princess Kaguya sits by the window, her expression serene and her eyes deep with thought. She holds a piece of paper inscribed with her condition.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 第一个是石竹皇子，他去取天竺的佛钵，但取来的是假的，被辉夜姬识破。
Plot Correspondence.en: The first was Prince Ishizukuri, who attempted to fetch the Buddha’s bowl from India but brought back a fake, which Princess Kaguya saw through.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，辉夜姬的闺房内，桌上放着一个佛钵，光线明亮
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside Princess Kaguya’s chamber, a Buddha’s bowl placed on the table, bright lighting

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 石竹皇子站在辉夜姬面前，表情紧张，手中捧着佛钵；辉夜姬表情冷淡，轻轻摇头
Static Shot Description.en: Prince Ishizukuri stands before Princess Kaguya, looking nervous as he holds the bowl. Princess Kaguya, expression cold, shakes her head slightly.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 第二个是车持皇子，他去取蓬莱的玉枝，结果是伪造的，也被辉夜姬识破。
Plot Correspondence.en: The second was Prince Kuramochi, who sought the jeweled branch from Mount Hōrai, but it was a forgery, and Princess Kaguya saw through it as well.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，辉夜姬的闺房内，桌上放着一支玉枝，光线明亮
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside Princess Kaguya’s chamber, a jeweled branch placed on the table, bright lighting

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 车持皇子站在辉夜姬面前，表情沉稳，手中拿着玉枝；辉夜姬表情冷淡，轻轻摇头
Static Shot Description.en: Prince Kuramochi stands before Princess Kaguya, his demeanor composed as he holds the branch. Princess Kaguya, expression cold, shakes her head slightly.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 第三个是右大臣阿部御主人，他去取火鼠裘，结果也是假的，被辉夜姬烧掉。
Plot Correspondence.en: The third was Minister Abe no Udomaro, who tried to procure the fireproof robe of a fire rat, but it was also a fake, and Princess Kaguya burned it.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，辉夜姬的闺房内，桌上放着一件火鼠裘，光线明亮
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside Princess Kaguya’s chamber, a fireproof robe placed on the table, bright lighting

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 右大臣阿部御主人站在辉夜姬面前，表情和蔼，手中拿着火鼠裘；辉夜姬表情冷淡，手中拿着火把，火鼠裘被点燃
Static Shot Description.en: Minister Abe no Udomaro stands before Princess Kaguya, his expression kind as he holds the robe. Princess Kaguya, expression cold, holds a torch as the robe catches fire.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 第四个是大伴御行大纳言，他去取龙头上的玉，结果自己掉进锅里受伤，没有取到。
Plot Correspondence.en: The fourth was Great Minister Ōtomo no Miyuki, who went to retrieve the dragon’s jewel but fell into a pot and injured himself, failing in his quest.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，辉夜姬的闺房内，光线明亮
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside Princess Kaguya’s chamber, bright lighting

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 大伴御行大纳言站在辉夜姬面前，表情尴尬，身上有伤痕；辉夜姬表情冷淡，轻轻摇头
Static Shot Description.en: Great Minister Ōtomo no Miyuki stands before Princess Kaguya, appearing embarrassed and bearing visible injuries. Princess Kaguya, expression cold, shakes her head slightly.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 第五个是中纳言石上麻吕，他去取燕子的子安贝，结果取到的是燕子粪，没有成功。
Plot Correspondence.en: The fifth was Middle Counselor Isonokami no Maro, who sought the swallow’s cowry shell but only found swallow droppings, failing as well.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，辉夜姬的闺房内，桌上放着一个盒子，光线明亮
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside Princess Kaguya’s chamber, a box placed on the table, bright lighting

Shot Perspective Design.en: Medium close up, eye level shot

Static Shot Description.ch: 中纳言石上麻吕站在辉夜姬面前，表情无奈，手中拿着盒子；辉夜姬表情冷淡，轻轻摇头
Static Shot Description.en: Middle Counselor Isonokami no Maro stands before Princess Kaguya, looking resigned as he holds the box. Princess Kaguya, expression cold, shakes her head slightly.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 皇帝也想娶辉夜姬，但被她拒绝。后来，皇帝去打猎时见到了辉夜姬，但仍然没有成功。
Plot Correspondence.en: The Emperor also sought to marry Princess Kaguya but was refused. Later, when he encountered her while hunting, he still failed to win her over.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，山林中，树木繁茂，鸟兽出没，光线明亮
Setting Description.en: Daytime, in the forest, dense trees, wildlife present, bright lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 皇帝骑在马上，身后跟着侍卫，表情威严；辉夜姬站在远处，表情冷淡，转身离去
Static Shot Description.en: The Emperor sits atop his horse, followed by guards, his expression regal. Princess Kaguya stands in the distance, her expression cold as she turns to leave.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 最后，辉夜姬告诉老人，她是月亮上的人，要回去了。
Plot Correspondence.en: Finally, Princess Kaguya told the old man that she was from the moon and must return.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚，赞岐造麻吕的房间内，窗外月光皎洁，光线柔和
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, inside Sanuki no Takamuro’s room, moonlight streaming through the window, soft lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 辉夜姬站在赞岐造麻吕面前，表情平静，眼神中带着一丝不舍；赞岐造麻吕坐在竹椅上，表情悲伤，双手颤抖
Static Shot Description.en: Princess Kaguya stands before Sanuki no Takamuro, her expression serene but her eyes tinged with sorrow. Sanuki no Takamuro sits on a bamboo chair, his face grief-stricken and his hands trembling.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 十五日那天，月亮上的人来接她，她穿上天的羽衣，忘记了一切忧患，升天而去。
Plot Correspondence.en: On the fifteenth day, the celestial beings from the moon came for her. She donned the robe of feathers, forgot all earthly sorrows, and ascended to the heavens.

Setting Description.ch: 夜晚，庭院中，月光如水，树影婆娑，光线明亮
Setting Description.en: Nighttime, in the courtyard, moonlight shimmering, shadows of trees swaying, bright lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 辉夜姬站在庭院中央，身穿天的羽衣，黑发飘扬，表情平静，身体缓缓升起
Static Shot Description.en: Princess Kaguya stands at the center of the courtyard, clad in the robe of feathers, her black hair flowing. Her expression is peaceful as she slowly rises into the sky.

Plot Correspondence.ch: 老人因为悲伤过度而去世。皇帝也因为思念辉夜姬而不再快乐。
Plot Correspondence.en: The old man died of grief, and the Emperor, too, lost all joy from longing for Princess Kaguya.

Setting Description.ch: 白天，赞岐造麻吕的房间内，竹制的家具，墙上挂着竹器，光线昏黄
Setting Description.en: Daytime, inside Sanuki no Takamuro’s room, bamboo furniture, bamboo crafts hanging on the walls, dim lighting

Static Shot Description.ch: 赞岐造麻吕躺在床上，表情安详，已经去世；皇帝站在床边，表情悲伤，眼神空洞
Static Shot Description.en: Sanuki no Takamuro lies in bed, his expression peaceful in death. The Emperor stands beside the bed, his face sorrowful and his eyes empty.
